description: This is a Perl test script related to the curl project, used for preprocessing headers, scanning symbols and man pages, and verifying symbol documentation in the libcurl project.

methods.name: scanenum
methods.description: Runs the preprocessor on a header file to extract enum symbols starting with 'CURL'.

methods.name: scanheader
methods.description: Scans a header file for #define directives matching CURL symbols.

methods.name: scanallheaders
methods.description: Iterates over all header files in the curl include directory, scanning each.

methods.name: checkmanpage
methods.description: Processes a man page to find and record references to CURL-related symbols.

methods.name: scanman3dir
methods.description: Scans a directory for .3 man pages and processes each with checkmanpage.
